caption: The drawing depicts a cast iron bench with elaborate decorative motifs. The backrest and armrests are designed with intertwining vines, leaves, and bunches of grapes, forming an openwork pattern. The seat has a lattice structure, consisting of small, evenly spaced holes in a grid, bordered by a smooth edge. The legs of the bench are ornate, shaped like animal paws with additional vine and leaf details. The bench appears to be dark brown or aged bronze in color. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a small inset diagram showing a labeled outline of the bench with the dimensions: height 34 inches, width 43 inches, and seat height 18 inches. The entire composition is presented on a beige background with a thin red border framing the drawing.
title: Garden Bench
